intention: Recorded coach area announcement for family-school calm app

items.text: هَذَا مَكَانُ الْمُدَرِّبِ. هُنَا تَجِدُ أَدَوَاتٍ وَتَفَاصِيلَ أَكْثَرَ. لِلْعَوْدَةِ إِلَى الطِّفْلِ، اِضْغَطْ زِرَّ الْعَوْدَةِ.
This is the coach area. Here you can find more tools and details. To go back to the child, tap Return to Child.
